description: Opt-in hook wiring for agentic:agent-memory. Installing the plugin wires nothing; copy the three entries below into the hooks section of your settings.json (user or project) to run the loop unattended. SessionStart injects L3 (global persona) + L2 (current project context). UserPromptSubmit recalls relevant L1 atoms. SessionEnd asynchronously captures L0 into L1, detects contradictions, and stages promotions for human adoption. The UserPromptSubmit hook is provisional: DESIGN.md section 9.5 is an open decision whose option (c) is to drop it, because its 100ms recall budget is dominated by python interpreter cold-start. Every hook fails open (exit 0, no memory) and never blocks. Disable individually with AGENT_MEMORY_SESSIONSTART=0, AGENT_MEMORY_USERPROMPTSUBMIT=0, AGENT_MEMORY_SESSIONEND=0. The hook 'timeout' field is in SECONDS and 1 is its floor; the real requirement is the 100ms internal self-budget that user_prompt_submit.py enforces against its own monotonic clock (DESIGN.md section 5.2). If your settings file does not expand ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, substitute the absolute path of the installed agentic plugin.
